frames.title: Broken nights don't check your diary.
Leave room for rest on purpose.

slides.title: When you reach your stop cue
slides.body: What to do in the moment it arrives.

slides.title: Notice it, plainly
slides.body: "That's my cue." No argument, no extra set to prove a point.

slides.title: Stop, or step down
slides.body: Finish here, or switch to the gentle version for a few minutes.

slides.title: Call it complete
slides.body: You set the boundary earlier. Keeping it is the win.

slides.title: Note it neutrally
slides.body: "Stopped at 12 minutes." A fact, not a verdict.

slides.title: Don't bank the rest for tomorrow
slides.body: No doubling up. Tomorrow gets its own check.
